MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER, RECOMMENDATIONS

Streamwave is a music streaming service with 40 million monthly listeners. The Personalization team builds the models behind our home feed, radio and daily mixes.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Train, evaluate and deploy recommendation models using PyTorch and TensorFlow
2. Build feature pipelines in PySpark and Airflow on top of our Databricks lakehouse
3. Run A/B tests and analyze results with product analysts
4. Ship models to production with MLflow and Kubernetes, and monitor them for drift
5. Communicate findings to stakeholders across product and engineering

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
1. MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent experience
2. 4-7 years of experience in applied machine learning
3. Strong Python and SQL skills; experience with pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn
4. Solid foundation in statistics, deep learning and recommendation systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
1. Experience with large language models, embeddings or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
2. Familiarity with feature stores and real-time inference on AWS SageMaker
3. Publications at RecSys, KDD or NeurIPS
4. Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification
